# PDP.studio

> AI-powered product description page (PDP) production platform for e-commerce retailers. Built by Fullcast, Inc.

For complete product details, capabilities, pricing, comparisons, and FAQs, see: https://pdp.studio/llms-full.txt

PDP.studio transforms messy vendor data into polished, brand-consistent product listings at scale. It enables retailers to go from data ingestion to publish-ready product content in under 48 hours — a process that traditionally takes 3 to 6 weeks.

## Core Capabilities

- **Data Ingestion**: Extracts specs, dimensions, materials, and certifications from PDFs, CSVs, images, and spreadsheets automatically.
- **AI Image Analysis**: Reads product photography to pull accurate attributes directly from images.
- **Localization**: Adapts content per market — terminology, units, sizing, and compliance — not just literal translation.
- **Brand Enforcement**: Every output is checked against brand guidelines, style guides, and source data before publication.
- **AI Search Optimization**: Structures titles, descriptions, meta tags, and alt-text for discoverability across Google, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.
- **Zero Hallucinations**: All outputs are anchored to source product data. No fabricated specs or claims.

## Pricing

- **Boutique** ($1,399/month): Up to 1,000 SKUs/month. Spec extraction, SEO optimization.
- **Banner** ($3,499/month): Up to 10,000 SKUs/month. Image analysis, 5 language localizations, AI search optimization, priority support.
- **House** (Custom): Up to 100,000 SKUs/month. Unlimited localizations, custom PIM integrations, dedicated account manager, SLA guarantees.

## Integrations

Accessible via API. Compatible with any PIM that supports inbound data. Enterprise customers get direct PIM integration for automated content delivery.

## FAQ

### What types of product data can PDP.studio ingest?
Virtually any format: manufacturer PDFs, CSVs, raw images, and spreadsheets. Specs, dimensions, materials, and certifications are extracted automatically with no manual data entry.

### How does PDP.studio ensure accuracy?
Every output is anchored directly to source product data. Guardrails ensure no dimension, material, or certification is ever fabricated.

### How does localization work?
Content is adapted, not translated. The system knows that a "vest" in New York is a "waistcoat" in London and a "Weste" in Berlin, and automatically converts units, sizing, and compliance details per market.

### How long does it take to go live?
Under 48 hours from ingestion to publish-ready, compared to 3-6 weeks with traditional workflows.

### How does AI search optimization work?
Every title, description, meta tag, and alt-text field is structured for discoverability across traditional search engines, answer engines, and generative AI surfaces.
